summary: Wrote an 8-phase plan for detecting a stranded dispatch from its own stale heartbeat. Detection lands as one read-only probe script (dispatch-strand-probe.sh) implementing the measured three-term conjunction (stale heartbeat AND artifact quiescence AND commit quiescence), consumed by a new advisory postflight field (stranded_suspected, deliberately separate from stall_suspected), by skill-orchestrate Move 3's existing one-re-prompt relay, and by reconcile-task-status.sh's demotion gate. Prevention lands as Check K in lint-agent-contracts.sh over the detach-then-await-a-notification shape, with the two Lean contracts as curated exclusions.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase, 11.5-hour plan covering the detection probe and its three consumers, the per-context held-live documentation, and the prevention lint.

next_action_hint: Run /implement 405 to execute the plan. Phases 1 and 7 are independent and can run in parallel.
